ngaap.guidance: 2025 guidance updated 24-Apr-2025 for the CAS divestiture (~$525M less IMS revenue for the rest of the year) and the FOS realignment (~$300M of revenue from IMS to AR): Revenue $21.4B - $21.7B (prior $21.8B - $22.2B); adjusted segment operating margin mid - high 15%. Segments: CS $5.6B - $5.7B, ~25% (prior high 24%); IMS ~$6.3B (prior $7.0B - $7.2B), high 11% (prior low 12%); SAS $6.9B - $7.1B, low 12%; AR ~$2.8B (prior ~$2.5B), mid 12%. Non-GAAP diluted EPS $10.30 - $10.50 (previous $10.55 - $10.85; CAS divestiture ~(0.55); improved performance and capital deployment ~+0.25), growth 7% at mid-point. Adjusted free cash flow $2.4B - $2.5B. Other: FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~$15M; non-service FAS pension income ~$270M (prior ~$260M); net interest expense ~$600M (prior ~$630M); effective tax rate on non-GAAP income 11.0% - 12.0%; weighted-average diluted shares 188 - 189M (prior ~190M); capital expenditures ~2% of revenue.
ngaap.notes: From Q1-25 Non-GAAP diluted EPS no longer adds back amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (2024 comparatives recast: the amortization add-back and its tax effect removed); it = diluted EPS + merger, acquisition and divestiture-related expenses + business divestiture-related losses (gains) / impairment of goodwill and other assets + LHX NeXt implementation costs (+ accrued corporate charge in Q4-25) + "income taxes on above adjustments and other, net". Pension adjusted non-GAAP diluted EPS = non-GAAP diluted EPS less the after-tax per-share FAS/CAS operating adjustment and non-service FAS pension income. Adjusted segment operating income = operating income excluding all unallocated corporate items (incl. amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, corporate department expense, FAS/CAS operating adjustment and the significant items) and, from Q4-25, segment impairment of goodwill and other assets; i.e. the sum of segment operating income (+ segment impairments). Effective tax rate on non-GAAP income excludes the amortization add-back from 2025 (2024 comparatives recast: e.g. Q1-24 5.5% vs 13.1% originally). Free cash flow = operating cash flow - capital expenditures + proceeds from disposal of PP&E; adjusted free cash flow adds cash used for merger, acquisition and severance. Organic revenue excludes completed divestitures (antenna May-2024, AOT Jan-2025, CAS Mar-2025). items_tax_effect: the tax on the adjusting items nets to a $1M reduction of tax (73 GAAP vs 72 non-GAAP).
